title: Incognito Insight
tagline: Strategize, Prove, Connect: DeFi Adventures with zK Privacy!
description:
Have you ever faced a scenario where you want to prove someone what you have done on chain but you don't want to expose your address ? This is the problem we are addressing with our product: incognito insight.

With incognito inside, you can create a challenge where you ask someone to prove that they have used a certain product. For example, Uni swap, to swap a certain pool. For example USDT to Eth, for a certain period, for example last one month, and made more than a certain amount of money for example, 12% 

All the provers have to do is provide their wallet address in which they have done these transactions. The platform checks the profits they have made for the constraints the you had provided while creating the challenge. Then the platform puts the prover’s profits, along with the details of the challenge into a message and make the prover sign it. 

This payload is used to  create a proof, which then you, the challenge creator can verify without the prover needing to expose his actual address and in turn his strategy.
